caption:
Figure 2: Overview of the proposed UCMIT framework. At each scale, LCIT reconstructs RGB-
aligned thermal evidence from nearby thermal sources. REF then arbitrates between co-located and
transported evidence and regulates its residual injection into the RGB stream. The resulting multi-
scale representations are progressively aggregated for task-specific dense prediction.
